title: Proclamation No. 1172, s. 2026
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
PROCLAMATION NO.1172

DECLARING SATURDAY, 14 MARCH 2026, A SPECIAL (NON-WORKING) DAY IN
THE CITY OF PASSI, PROVINCE OF ILOILO

WHEREAS, on 14 March 2026, Saturday, the City of Passi, Province of Iloilo
will mark the celebration of its Founding Anniversary as a component city;

WHEREAS, it is but fitting and proper that the people of the City of Passi be
given full opportunity to participate in the occasion and enjoy the celebration;

NOW, THEREFORE, I, RALPH G. RECTO, Acting Executive Secretary, by
authority of the President, FERDINAND R. MARCOS, JR., do hereby declare
Saturday, 14 March 2026, a special (non-working) day in the City of Passi, Province
of Iloilo.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF., | have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of
the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.

Done in the City of Manila, this 20thday of February in the year of Our Lord,

Two Thousand and Twenty Six.

By authority of the President:

Acting Execftive/Secretary

the President
RECORDS OFFICE

TED COPY

 TOLENTINO-NAVA
DIRECTOR IV
